meta.title: Revised Lba And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer the LBA Budget Amendment No.1 for Fiscal Year 2021-22 item to another meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Local Building Authority Budget Amendment No.1 for FY2021-22, which covers bond debt services for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries, and refers it to a future meeting for action.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 44 of 2021 recognizing December 1 as World AIDS Day in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall officially recognizing December 1st as World AIDS Day in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 45 of 2021 declaring November 20 as Transgender Day of Remembrance.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall officially declaring November 20th as Transgender Day of Remembrance in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer Item E-1 (2022 State of Utah Asset Forfeiture Grant) to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Police Department's application for the 2022 State of Utah Asset Forfeiture Grant, which would fund an overt pole camera kit, narcan nasal spray, and drug prevention resource cards, and refers it to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action on the Rezone at 1945 South 1300 East to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed rezone of 1945 South 1300 East from RMF-35 to RMF-45 and defers action to a future meeting, amid neighborhood opposition.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing, adopt Ordinance 65 of 2021 Budget Amendment Part One to the FY2021-22 (excluding item G-5), and approve Resolution 46 of 2021 authorizing the grant application for the WaterSMART Reclamation for water and energy efficiency grants for Fiscal Year 2022.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 4 for FY2021-22 and adopts the first part of the budget amendment (excluding one item) along with a resolution authorizing a WaterSMART grant application; the amendment includes creating the Community Health Access Team, a park ranger pilot program, and various ARPA-funded initiatives.

votes.motion: Adopt Item G-5 for Budget Amendment Part One, Ordinance 65 of 2021.
votes.description: Adopts the previously excluded Item G-5 of Budget Amendment No. 4 Part One for FY2021-22; Councilmember Faris recused himself from this vote.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 66 of 2021 for the University Ivory House Zoning Map Amendment.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance rezoning a portion of 1780 East South Campus Drive from Institutional (I) to Residential/Mixed Use (R-MU) to accommodate a student housing development of approximately 536 units near the University of Utah.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 67 of 2021 Amending the City Code regarding Technology Related Land Use Text Amendments.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance amending Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to add and update definitions and permitted uses for biomedical, technology facility, data center, laboratory, and research and development facility uses in various zoning districts citywide.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 68 of 2021 enacting temporary zoning regulations authorizing a temporary overflow homeless shelter use at approximately 1659 West North Temple Street, subject to conditions including a perimeter fence, submission of a security and operations plan, a collaborative police public safety plan, economic development mitigation for nearby businesses, and a legislative action reviewing restrictions on temporary shelters until other jurisdictions permit them.
votes.description: Adopts temporary zoning regulations to allow an overflow homeless shelter at approximately 1659 West North Temple Street during the winter, with conditions on fencing, security planning, law enforcement coordination, business mitigation, and a future review of shelter siting policy. The vote was 5-2 with Petro-Eschler and Valdemoros dissenting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 47 of 2021 designating the Salt Lake City, Utah Central Business Improvement Assessment Area No. DA-CBIA-22 and adopt Resolution 48 of 2021 appointing a Board of Equalization for the area, including appointment of Jennifer Bruno, Ben Luedtke, or Nick Tarbet as Council representatives as needed, and authorizing the City Recorder to publish notice of assessments and hearings.
votes.description: Designates the Central Business Improvement Assessment Area and appoints a Board of Equalization to hear objections to proposed assessments, following a protest period in which only 0.02% of commercial taxable properties filed protests.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 49 of 2021 authorizing a master lease agreement between the City and JP Morgan Chase Bank for vehicle leasing and purchasing services.
votes.description: Authorizes a Municipal Master Lease Agreement with JP Morgan Chase Bank, N.A. for vehicle leasing and purchasing services, allowing lease agreements up to $7M per year with an aggregate cap of $35M over the five-year term.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda for November 16, 2021.
votes.description: Approves all items on the consent agenda, including setting public hearing dates for several ordinances and approving the appointment of Angela Dean to the Art Design Advisory Board through November 16, 2024.
Formal motion to adjourn the November 16, 2021 City Council meeting.
